name: Lucid Escape
source:
Have you ever wondered what you can do if you can control your dreams? In Lucid Escape you will step into the fantasies of our character. For the first time will you be able to control whatever you dream of or shaken by your own mind. Jump into fantasies and see what you can do in movie theater and private dorm room. Escape from reality and join us on this astral adventure.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/lucid-escape]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过，如果你能控制自己的梦想，你能做什么？在《清醒逃脱》中，你将步入我们角色的幻想之中。你将第一次能够控制你的梦想或被你自己的思想所动摇的任何东西。沉浸在幻想中，看看你可以在电影院和私人宿舍里做什么。逃离现实，加入我们的星际冒险吧。

[来自[url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/lucid-escape]Itch.io[/url]]
